profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Ripple | Treasury | Payments | FinTech | Data Analytics | Azure
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer specializing in .NET, Azure, and distributed systems — building reliable infrastructure for high-stakes financial platforms at Ripple Treasury.

My path from Engineering Manager to Application Architect to Staff Engineer has shaped a rare blend of technical depth and leadership perspective. I design cloud-native systems, lead platform architecture, and drive technical hiring — all in environments where performance and uptime aren't optional.

PSM II certified. Azure practitioner. Passionate about distributed systems, strong teams, and software that just works.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Staff Software Engineer with deep expertise in .NET, Azure, and distributed systems, specializing in high-availability payment platforms and cloud-native architecture.

At Ripple Treasury, I lead the design and delivery of critical bank connectivity infrastructure and platform services powering real-time payment transactions at scale. My work spans Azure Functions, Service Bus, multi-tenant architecture, and production reliability engineering — including fraud detection systems, Hangfire job processing optimization, and SQL Server performance tuning under high-concurrency workloads.

I bring a systems-thinking mindset to complex problems: architecting solutions from first principles, driving technical hiring, and mentoring engineers across distributed teams. I have a strong foundation in CS fundamentals including distributed consistency, event-driven design, and fault-tolerant systems.

Core focus areas:
• .NET / C# — enterprise-grade, production systems
• Azure cloud architecture — Functions, Service Bus, multi-tenant SaaS
• Distributed systems — reliability, observability, performance
• Payment platform engineering — high-stakes, low-latency connectivity
• Technical leadership — hiring, mentorship, cross-team architecture
positions.insights: Skills: Data Engineering · Python (Programming Language) · Machine Learning

positions.title: Application Architect
positions.description:
Collaborate with an agile team to design, develop, test, and maintain scalable SaaS web applications using Microsoft technologies, including .NET, C#, and SQL Server.
Architect cloud-native solutions leveraging Azure services such as App Services, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps, and Azure SQL to ensure scalability, reliability, and performance.
Partner with fellow architects to drive critical product architecture decisions, aligning technical direction with business goals and industry best practices.
Lead and participate in code and design reviews to maintain high standards of quality and consistency across the codebase.
Diagnose and resolve complex issues related to application performance, availability, and bugs in production and development environments.
Author detailed technical design documentation and architectural diagrams for medium to large-scale initiatives.
Collaborate with the Development Manager to lead a large, cross-functional development team—delegating tasks, tracking progress, and removing blockers.
Work with Product Management to deconstruct business requirements into actionable user stories and technical solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Application Architecture · Application Solution Design · .NET Core · SQL Server · Angular · ASP.NET Core · Microsoft Azure · Agile Software Development · Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) · Cross-functional Team Leadership · System Architecture · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Software Architectural Design

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Lead and manage Agile projects and development teams, ensure the delivery process go smoothly and bring value to client.
Team and individual coaching on development process and career growth. Conduct training and facilitate program to hire and develop talents for the project and company.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Tech Lead and Team Lead – Worked on software outsourcing projects, played technical lead/team lead of a development team, provided guidance, best practices, and coaching, mentoring, support and client communications. Led and managed development team of 10-12 people working on offshore product projects using Scrum/Kanban framework to deliver product to US/Europe clients.

positions.title: Business Application Consultant
positions.description:
Consultant in a SharePoint project.
Lead a team to handle application issues, change requests. Gather user requirement and develop implementation plan. Carry out root cause analysis, provide solution and fix bugs and implement new changes. Support testing and user acceptance testing. 

Monitor team member progress and weekly update progress to Project Manager. Attend weekly meeting with Project Manager and client to update work progress and discuss working plan. Attend call with offshore team to transfer task and technically discuss issues or solution to fixing issues. 

Monitor system and resources to maintain the system availability and take care of any failure of system. 

Discuss and negotiate with business users about the changes and support signing off documents and implementation from start to finish.
Deployment changes to each environment for testing and PROD.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer - SharePoint Consultant
positions.description:
Continuously working on web-based application projects for commercial and corporation system in the US and UAE.
Played a role as technical lead of 15 people in a SharePoint project for Financial firm in Dubai, UAE. (Onsite working)

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
A lead software engineer working for Factory Automation (FA) division, worked in projects in FA domain going across the SDLC.
1 year onsite in Japan as a contractor for a multinational corporation with major responsibility is to develop and test an automation system in a semiconductor chip plant.

projects.title: SharePoint Intranet Portal
projects.description: An intranet website for a financial firm which is used by all employees in the organization. The system enables user to submit e-forms and processed by underlying business workflow. Workflow is designed and implemented by using Nintex Workflow software. The system also support advanced features for business users such as documents, photos sharing, tasks management, search, etc.

projects.title: B&T TS360 Support
projects.description:
Baker & Taylor has the stated goal of having a best-of-breed B2B eCommerce site that will enable all of their customers to easily search for and discover physical and digital products while efficiently managing their purchasing process and enabling B&T to retain its leadership position in worldwide distribution.
• The eCommerce application will bring together the functionalities within Title Source 3, School Selection, B&T Link Online, Compass, and parts of OCS. The application will also expand and add newer features detailed in the functional requirements.
• The eCommerce application will allow customers extensive Browse & Search as well as Cart/Grid Management capability. It will enable extended Marketing functionality such as personalization, targeted campaigns, social networking to make their buying experience rich and rewarding. 
• Administrative features such as setting up customers, cart groups, discount plans, defining permissions, and workflow related activities will make the new eCommerce application a powerful tool for B&T and customer administrative staff.
• The application will allow internal and external users to generate reports dynamically for their own analysis. These reports will be used by both internal staff and customers.
• The application will employ centralized authentication and authorization enabling single sign on and user access to applications and systems participating in the B&T solution.
• As part of the solution, an integration hub will be built that facilitates interfaces and the web presentation of the site. The hub will employ both package and custom components to enable integration between the eCommerce Application and Enterprise Resource Systems such as SOP & TOLAS as well as Enterprise Applications such as CAT, CDMS, ODS, Content Cafe2 etc.
